  • Method Details

    • createUser

      @Transactional public User createUser(User user, Set<UserRole> userRoles) throws org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException
      Creates a new user in the system and assigns the specified roles.

      This method performs the following steps:

      1. Sets a default profile image if none is provided.
      2. Encrypts the user's password using BCryptPasswordEncoder.
      3. Checks if the username is already taken by calling checkExistingUserByUserName(User).
      4. Assigns and persists the specified roles using manageRoles(User, Set).
      5. Saves the user in the database via UserRepository.
      Specified by:
      createUser in interface IUserService
      Parameters:
      user - the User object to be created
      userRoles - the set of UserRole objects to assign to the user
      Returns:
      the saved User entity with roles assigned
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - if a user with the same username already exists (HTTP 409 Conflict)

    • updateUser

      @Transactional public User updateUser(Long userId, User updatedUser)
      Updates the details of an existing user.

      This method fetches the user by ID and updates only the fields provided in the updatedUser object. Fields that are null will remain unchanged. Logs are added to track which fields are being updated.

      Specified by:
      updateUser in interface IUserService
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user to update
      updatedUser - a User object containing the updated fields
      Returns:
      the updated User entity
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - if the user with the given ID does not exist (HTTP 404)

    • updatePassword

      public void updatePassword(Long userId, String newPassword)
      Updates the password of an existing user.

      This method performs the following steps:

      • Logs the incoming request to update the password.
      • Retrieves the user by ID from the repository.
      • Throws a ResponseStatusException with 404 NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist.
      • Validates that the new password is not null or blank, otherwise throws a ResponseStatusException with 400 BAD_REQUEST.
      • Encodes the new password using the configured PasswordEncoder.
      • Updates and persists the user entity with the encoded password.
      • Logs the successful password update.
      Specified by:
      updatePassword in interface IUserService
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user whose password should be updated
      newPassword - the new password to be set; must not be null or blank
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - if the user is not found (404) or if the password is null or blank (400)
